Definition: Does the register cover births, deaths and marriages?
Comments: Covers births, marriages, deaths via MonActe platform.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed. MonActe (mon-acte.ci) processes birth, marriage and death certificates online, and the Interior Ministry's 2023 civil-status annuaire (UNICEF-supported, published 2024/2025) confirms all three vital-event types are digitally captured. Value Code 3 (All) stands.

Definition: What proportion of the population does the register cover?
Comments: Birth registration completeness 72% (MICS 2016); recent est. 71.7%. Proxy for coverage.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The 2016 MICS 72% figure cited is stale and completeness has since declined. A 2024 UPR civil-society factsheet (drawing on UNICEF data) reports 35% of under-5s unregistered at birth in 2021 (up from 29% in 2019), i.e. ~65% completeness and falling. Ministry of Interior/UNICEF annual civil-status statistics (2025, covering 2024 data) show the on-time birth registration rate has fallen further, to 55.4% in 2024 from 66.8% in 2021. Combined evidence points to completeness now below the 70% threshold, so downgraded to Value Code 3 (50-69%).

Comments: Digital electoral register: CEI provisional list 2025 online verification.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed. The CEI's definitive electoral roll for 2025 (8,727,431 electors, finalised 2 June 2025) is a nationally maintained digital database, individually searchable online and used operationally for the October 2025 presidential and December 2025 legislative elections. Value Code 5 (Fully deployed nationwide) stands.

Definition: What proportion of the electorate does the register cover?
Comments: 8.7M registered voters out of est. eligible ~18M adults (>89%).
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The original comment's own arithmetic was wrong: 8.7M/18M is ~48%, not >89%. International IDEA's Voter Turnout Database gives a 2025 voting-age population (VAP) of 17,233,507 against registration of 8,568,456-8,727,431 depending on the exact list used, i.e. ~49.7-50.6% coverage of the voting-age population — not >89%. Corrected to Value Code 3 (50-69%), noting this sits right at the lower boundary of the band; human review recommended given the sensitivity to which registered-voter figure is used.

Definition: Does the government maintain a separate cadastral register?
Comments: Separate digital cadastral efforts: IDUFCI unique land identifier, GIS expansion, mining cadastre digital.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Decree No. 2019-221 (official legal text, verified via the CNDJ legal database) confirms IDUFCI is a nationwide, mandatory 20-character spatial parcel identifier covering both urban and rural land domains, operationalised through the SIGFU platform. This corroborates 'partially deployed' — the legal/technical framework is national but IDUFCI numbers are only assigned as parcels pass through transactions, so full parcel-by-parcel coverage is not yet achieved. A third-party blog claims 332,462 km² already registered 'to 1m² accuracy', but that source is a promotional/content site with unreliable dating (some pages dated 2026) and could not be corroborated against a primary government statistic — flagged for human review rather than used to justify a higher code. Value Code 4 retained.

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more social protection registers?
Comments: Registre Social Unique (RSU) partially deployed; >200k households registering 2025, prior 720k registered.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed and updated. As of August 2025, the RSU's own operator (BCP Filets Sociaux) reports over 1.45 million households (8.8 million individuals) already enrolled, against a 2021-2025 target of over 2 million households (Ministry of Solidarity, 2023), with continuous rolling enrolment (a further 70,000+ households launched June 2025). This is national in scope but not yet complete against its own target, supporting Value Code 4 (Partially deployed); code unchanged but evidence base strengthened with fresher, government-sourced figures.

Definition: Is the register integrated with the business register?
Comments: Business registration generates TIN via CEPICI.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Decree No. 2015-287 of 29 April 2015 (official gazette text) mandates that company registration at the RCCM (business/companies register), the tax administration's taxpayer file, CNPS and the external trade register all occur simultaneously and automatically generate one shared unique identifier (IDU), processed nationwide by CEPICI. The operational idu.ci portal and CEPICI's 'Annuaire IDU' confirm this is live in practice, not just legislated. This is stronger evidence of full, automatic, nationwide integration than the original single low-authority advisory-firm source, so upgraded from Value Code 4 to 5 (Fully integrated nationwide).

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more tax registers?
Comments: Digital tax registers: e-Impôts portal (74k adherents 2022), recensement électronique launched 2025.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed. e-impots.gouv.ci is the Direction Générale des Impôts' official national e-filing/e-payment portal, and the Ministry of Finance's own portal (APIF, 2022) corroborates the 74,000-adherent figure and confirms the portal has operated nationwide since 2017. Value Code 5 (Fully deployed nationwide) stands, though the modest 74k-adherent base (relative to the taxpayer population) is a separate uptake question, not addressed by this Status variable.

Definition: Does the register manage income tax, business taxes or both?
Comments: Covers income and business taxpayers (TIN/IDU for all).
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Confirmed, but original source (taxdo.com) was a low-authority aggregator FAQ with suspect future-dated content; replaced with primary sources. e-impots.gouv.ci offers distinct 'Entreprises' and 'Particuliers/Avis d'imposition' (individual synthetic and property tax) spaces, and Decree No. 2015-287 confirms the unique taxpayer/business identifier regime covers both individual and business taxpayers. Value Code 4 (Both income and business taxpayers) stands.
